svg.title: The health desk, twenty past four
svg.desc: The health desk of a newspaper with a printed press release, a preprint on screen, a whiteboard carrying a base rate, a phone on speaker and a headline draft on a sticky note.

g.text: The health desk, twenty past four
Twelve things to find. Two of them carry the same number and one says what it is out of.
the style guide, open at RISK
the correction log
the deadlines
the standards corner
the preprint, on screen
the whiteboard: 4 in 10,000
the release
the health desk
the chart with the shaded band
the headline draft
the calculator
the back bench
the style guide, open at RISK
the correction log, four years of it
the clock: twenty past four
Hana - she has read the preprint
Priya - the first edition closes at six
the headline draft, on a sticky note
the chart, with its shaded band
the phone, on speaker to an epidemiologist
